transformName.description: The name of the overridden {@link Transform}.

addedFieldCount.description: Count of the number of added fields to the {@link Transform}.

modifiedSource.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link Transform#source}. Set to null if no modification is
made to the transform's source.

modifiedTarget.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link Transform#target}. Set to null if no modification is
made to the transform's target.

modifiedTargetCollection.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link Transform#targetCollection}. Set to null if no modification is
made to the transform's targetCollection.

modifiedCondition.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link Transform#condition}. Set to null if no modification is
made to the transform's condition.

modifiedTransformer.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link Transform#transformer}. Set to null if no modification is
made to the transform's transformer.

overriddenFields.description: The list of overridden transform fields.

title: Type to capture information about an overridden {@link Transform} and the nature of the override.
name: BaseCustomizationAnalysis.Di.Overrides.Transform
